coordinate_frame: ZED rectified LEFT optical; metres; +X right,+Y down,+Z forward
lossless_pointcloud_encoding: PCD2; all original float32 XYZ and uint8 RGB bits preserved

content_quality_review.scope: Severe transient stereo-wrap signature; not absolute depth accuracy.

robot_pose_method: nominal UF850 URDF FK from measured joint sequence, interpolated at camera post-grab host time
gripper_pose_method: fixed nominal stock gripper opening, operator-reported UI89 -> drive_joint0.761rad
candidate_point_semantics: Stable surface tool candidates; not observed rope contacts or verified no-slip material identities.

model_download.scope: all UF850 arm and stock gripper visual geometry; derived nominal visual/FK subset, not full dynamics

limitations: Nominal URDF is not individual robot calibration or absolute physical accuracy acceptance.
Joint/camera association uses approximate host timing, not exposure/controller synchronization.
Inherited ZED optical profile compatibility remains pending.
The downloadable model is a visual/FK subset; it omits inertia, collision geometry and hardware-control plugins.
